section.heading: Featured Work
section.description: Personal products I build end to end, and professional platforms I have shipped and scaled with teams.

personal.title: get1agent
personal.summary: A fully serverless, multi-tenant AWS platform for building, running and sharing agents, MCP tools and RAG pipelines. Ships an AI-assisted MCP server builder, an evaluation lab with LLM judges and annotation queues, Bedrock Guardrails, an agent marketplace and a skills catalog.
bullets: Agent runtime with a planner, long-term memory, context compression and human-in-the-loop interrupts, with inline citations.
Multi-agent workflow builder: deterministic Graph and dynamic Swarm orchestration with a live run timeline.
Citing RAG: hybrid semantic + BM25 search fused with RRF, Bedrock Rerank and small-to-big retrieval.
fullDetails: Multi-tenant serverless platform on AWS Lambda and Bedrock AgentCore where users build and share knowledge bases, agents, workflows, skills and tools, with per-user quotas and a KMS-encrypted, operator-blind BYOK vault.

Agent runtime: a planner that decomposes requests into sub-queries and todo steps, long-term memory, context compression, human-in-the-loop interrupts, and a chat with inline citations and feedback (Strands Agents + Bedrock AgentCore).
Workflow builder on Strands Agents: deterministic Graph and dynamic Swarm orchestration — coordinator host, parallel execution, per-node overrides and a live run timeline.

MCP layer: five servers (knowledge, code interpreter, web fetch, browser, custom tools), an OAuth 2.0 broker for third-party servers and policy-checked AgentCore Gateway routing — plus an AI-assisted builder that generates and sandbox-tests custom MCP servers in microVMs.

Retrieval that cites its sources: event-driven ingestion (PDF, DOCX, XLSX), hybrid semantic + keyword search (Titan embeddings in S3 Vectors, BM25) fused with RRF, Bedrock Rerank, small-to-big retrieval and page/sheet citations.

Quality and operations: trace replay with A/B model runs, datasets and annotation queues, Ragas-aligned LLM judges, signed trace links, Bedrock Guardrails, OpenTelemetry into CloudWatch/X-Ray, AI-credit budgets and cost levers (prompt caching, semantic cache).

professional.title: Pitch Intel
professional.summary: Agentic sales-intelligence platform that turns research into ready-to-send pitch material. It cuts pitch-report preparation from ~3 days to ~30 minutes, with a drag-and-drop agent workflow builder and multi-format output.
bullets: Cuts pitch-report preparation from ~3 days to ~30 minutes.
Drag-and-drop builder for composing agentic workflows from reusable agents, with a shared gallery and RBAC.
Delivers reports as infographics, HTML, PDF and PowerPoint.
professional.caseStudy: Sales and commercial-pricing teams were spending days gathering public information, proprietary company data and past history before a pitch. The goal was to cut that time with AI-generated, research-backed pitch material.
fullDetails: Planner agent plus specialised sub-agents (web research, current packages, battlecards, pitch generation) orchestrated into a single workflow.
Drag-and-drop UI to compose workflows from reusable agents, publish them to a shared gallery, and manage access with role-based access control.
Reports grounded in approved web sources, proprietary company data and sales MCP servers, delivered as infographics, HTML, PDF and PowerPoint.
Any MCP server and its tools can be plugged into a workflow.

professional.title: Chat AI MCP Server
professional.summary: Customer-facing MCP server exposing the SPGCI Python SDK for structured and unstructured data. Adopted by 100+ customers across MS Copilot, Claude and Databricks, with no repeated SME review cycles.
bullets: Adopted by 100+ customers across MS Copilot, Claude and Databricks.
Executes LLM-generated SDK code for structured data and AIRD APIs for unstructured data.
Reused core Chat AI prompts for answer parity — no repeated SME review cycles.
professional.caseStudy: The business wanted to offer MCP as a service to customers without losing the accuracy and reliability of the existing Chat AI product, and without repeating SME evaluation for every new tool.
fullDetails: Five MCP tools covering structured and unstructured retrieval for the customer-facing Chat AI team.
LLM-generated code execution in an isolated sandbox (AgentCore Code Interpreter) for structured data.
AIRD (AI-Ready Data) APIs for unstructured data, reusing the team's core prompts for answer parity.
URL parameters and environment variables make it easy to onboard additional datasets.

professional.title: RAPID MCP Server
professional.summary: Turns a 300+ API surface into a single MCP interface — searchable and executable with no microservice changes. A search-and-rerank strategy lifted LLM API-selection accuracy from ~85% to 95%+.
bullets: Four tools (instructions, search, metadata, execute) cover the whole API surface.
No microservice code changes — saving hundreds of engineering hours.
Search-and-rerank discovery lifted API-selection accuracy from ~85% to 95%+.
professional.caseStudy: RAPID microservices are generated and deployed by an automation framework. The business wanted the same treatment for MCP — hundreds of APIs exposed as tools without touching microservice code.
fullDetails: Owned the MCP architecture end to end: 300+ APIs exposed through four tools (instructions, search, metadata, execute).
Search-and-rerank discovery strategy — the model searches the toolset, reviews the top-k candidates, then executes the right endpoint.
Zero microservice changes, saving hundreds of engineering hours; LLM API-selection accuracy improved from ~85% to 95%+.
Now widely used across internal AI applications.

professional.title: MCP Playground
professional.summary: Playground for testing MCP servers against multiple models with real queries before production. Now used by 10+ teams, with a consistency framework that scores release confidence.
bullets: Used by 10+ teams to validate servers against multiple models.
Streams tool-call events live so teams can see exactly what the model did.
Consistency framework compares tool calls and arguments across repeated runs.
professional.caseStudy: Teams wanted to validate MCP tool accuracy and consistency — including actual tool executions — before committing to a production integration.
fullDetails: Add MCP servers through the UI and stream events as tools execute, with multimodal output support.
Run real queries against multiple models and compare responses side by side.
Consistency module repeats the same test queries and measures tool calls and arguments across runs.
Produces a release-confidence score so teams know when a server is ready for production.

professional.title: API Platform
professional.summary: Deployment, security and observability for 15+ microservices on Kubernetes. Moved raw manifests to Helm charts, fixed critical vulnerabilities and added dashboards over cluster events and metrics.
bullets: Raw Kubernetes manifests to Helm charts — ~25% less deploy-day friction.
Fixed critical vulnerabilities and purged hardcoded secrets from git history across 10 repositories.
OpenSearch dashboards over Kubernetes events and metrics for faster triage.
professional.caseStudy: A platform team owning 15+ microservices needed faster, safer releases and better production visibility across the cluster estate.
fullDetails: Modernised deployment for 15+ microservices from raw Kubernetes manifests to Helm charts, cutting deploy-day friction by ~25%.
Overhauled platform security with Fluent Bit, OpenTelemetry and Data Prepper, fixed critical vulnerabilities and purged hardcoded secrets from git history across 10 repositories.
Instrumented OpenSearch dashboards over Kubernetes events and metrics, giving teams faster detection and triage of production issues.

professional.title: Product Intelligence Agent
professional.summary: Text2SQL chat app so the product team can query orders, complaints and products in natural language. A LangGraph feedback loop self-corrects SQL errors and cut ad-hoc data-team requests by ~25%.
bullets: Cut ad-hoc data-team requests by ~25%.
LangGraph nodes and edges create a feedback loop that self-corrects SQL errors.
Watchdog agent surfaces emerging issues such as shortages, waste and delays.
professional.caseStudy: The product team depended on data teams for customer insights and trends. The goal was to let them ask questions in natural language instead of waiting on ad-hoc analysis.
fullDetails: Text2SQL chat application over orders, complaints and products, cutting ad-hoc data-team requests by ~25%.
LangGraph node-and-edge design lets the agent automate its own SQL error-correction loop.
Automatic data sampling, query examples and column descriptions improve query accuracy and consistency.
Watchdog agent on the same product logic proactively surfaces emerging issues — paper shortages, material alternatives, waste and delivery delays.

professional.title: Forge Module
professional.summary: Production microservices replacing legacy Forge systems — PDF generation, cutlines and template mapping. Built on RabbitMQ with Celery workers, lifting throughput ~50% and cutting material waste.
bullets: RabbitMQ with Celery workers, lifting throughput ~50%.
Replaced a monolith that had become the scalability bottleneck for the Erlang OTP engine.
New template product lines reached customers faster.
professional.caseStudy: An existing monolith had become the bottleneck for Erlang OTP engine scalability, so new microservices were needed for Forge to improve throughput and performance.
fullDetails: New microservices for PDF generation, cutlines and template mapping on RabbitMQ with Celery workers, lifting throughput ~50%.
Cutlines reduced material wastage and saved thousands of dollars in material costs.
XML templates for new product lines shortened time to market and brought in new customers.

professional.title: Mnesia DB Viewer
professional.summary: Web app to inspect, correct, backup and restore Mnesia DB data during peak-season incidents. A Python subprocess approach with Erlang OTP tooling saved ~$10K per production incident.
bullets: Python subprocess approach into the Erlang cluster.
REST APIs to update Mnesia rows and push them back.
Automated backup and restore flows.
professional.caseStudy: In peak season, bad asset or order data could corrupt the Mnesia DB and bring the Erlang engine down, so the client needed a safe way to correct and restore data.
fullDetails: Full-stack web application for managing Mnesia DB data using a Python subprocess approach.
REST APIs to update Mnesia rows and push them back, with Erlang OTP cluster tooling for diagnosis.
Automated restore and backup of Mnesia DB data.
Saved ~$10K per production incident by cutting diagnosis and recovery time.

professional.title: Ledger Insights
professional.summary: Modernised a finance and accounting platform from legacy .NET to Python, React, AWS and PostgreSQL. Delivered premium features such as AR Requests, CFO Reports and trade groups, lifting retention ~35%.
bullets: Legacy .NET to Python, React, AWS and PostgreSQL — retention up ~35%.
Premium features across backend and React — ~$150K in B2B deals.
Trade groups, CFO reports, AR requests and debtor payment trends.
professional.caseStudy: Ledger Insights existed to close the gaps in Ledger 3D, which lacked trade groups, reports, accounts receivable and debtor payment trends — and it needed modernising without losing those capabilities.
fullDetails: Drove the platform's migration from legacy .NET to Python, React, AWS and PostgreSQL, improving UX and lifting customer retention ~35%.
Built the missing premium capabilities: AR Requests, CFO Reports, trade groups, Combined Experience and debtor payment trends.
Scaled backend services and the React pages that supported B2B deals worth ~$150K.
CI/CD pipeline on Azure Pipelines to automate deployment.

professional.title: Global Data Editing Tool
professional.summary: Data governance app to correct inaccurate and redundant company data across entities. Flask editing workflows raised data quality from ~85% to ~95%, with audited edits pushed back to production.
bullets: Flask editing application used across entities — data quality ~85% to ~95%.
REST APIs over US customer data with authorization workflows.
Audited edits flow back into production databases.
professional.caseStudy: Vendor-supplied data was not always accurate or current, so the business needed a structured way to correct it and push audited changes back into production.
fullDetails: Flask data-editing application used across entities to rectify incorrect and redundant company data, raising data quality from ~85% to ~95%.
REST APIs integrated into customer-facing platforms for additional data checks and edits.
Authorization workflows that push audited records back to production databases.
Dynamic per-entity forms and validation built with Jinja templates and WTForms.
